text:
Hi Diarmuid and friends,

We've tested these most recent changes and they work! Thank you very much
for making changes to your codebase so quickly.

We've got a few pressing deadlines to meet, so we can't implement all these
fixes immediately. For the time being we have inserted some sleep commands
to slow down API requests. We have also been able to implement the new
QueueRunner for one of our most used projects. So you should see our
request volume go down immediately in the short term, and then again in the
long term as we catch up. Let us know if our changes don't seem to be
reflected on your end. Over the next two weeks, we should be able to have
these fixes implemented for all our projects.

Cheers,

Daniel

OpenAI releases AgentKit, unifying agent building, evaluation, and deployment into a single toolkit
OpenRouter releases Sonoma Dusk Alpha with 2M token context
OpenAI introduced AgentKit at its Dev Day 2025 event, a new toolkit for building, deploying, and optimizing AI agents. It consolidates fragmented tools into a single platform with modules for workflow design, data governance, embedded UIs, evaluation, and fine-tuning.
Key Features
Agent Builder: Visual canvas for multi-agent workflows with versioning and guardrails.
Connector Registry: Central panel for managing data sources and third-party connectors.
ChatKit: Toolkit for embedding chat-based agent UIs into apps and sites
